sentences.text: Researchers analyzed a large group of people to determine if childhood abuse is linked to later dementia.

Those abused as children faced a much higher risk of developing dementia than those who were not, though four specific areas of health and lifestyle explained only a small part of this link, with mental health acting as the main driver among the factors.
The authors warn that their findings do not explain the full connection and that more research is needed on biological and social causes.
